description: This file contains unit tests for the Module class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing behavior of module error handling, required modules management, and disposal of advice point class instances.

classes.name: ModuleTest
classes.description: Test class for the Module class methods, verifying error handling, required module management, and advice point disposal.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes a Module instance before each test.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldThrowExceptionWhenMessageIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that setting a null startup error message throws ModuleException.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldThrowExceptionWhenThrowableIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that providing a null Throwable when setting error message throws ModuleException.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldsetStartupErrorMessageWhenExceptionMessageIsNull
methods.description: Checks that setting an error message with a ModuleException appends the exception message.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldAppendTheThrowablesMessageToExceptionMessage
methods.description: Verifies appending of exception message and throwable message to startup error message.

methods.name: setRequiredModules_shouldSetModulesWhenThereIsANullRequiredModulesMap
methods.description: Tests setting required modules list when the internal map is null.

methods.name: getRequiredModuleVersion_shouldReturnNullIfNoRequiredModulesExist
methods.description: Checks that querying module version returns null if no required modules are set.

methods.name: getRequiredModuleVersion_shouldReturnNullIfNoRequiredModuleByGivenNameExists
methods.description: Verifies that non-existent modules return null, existing modules return version.

methods.name: addRequiredModule_shouldAddModuleToRequiredModulesMap
methods.description: Tests adding a module to the required modules map and retrieving its version.

methods.name: disposeAdvicePointsClassInstance_shouldDisposeAllClassInstancesNotAdvicePoints
methods.description: Tests disposal of class instances within advice points; ensures instances are nullified.
